## Checklist

- [ ] If this finishes a milestone: its criteria are all met, `docs/ROADMAP.md` is updated (criteria ticked, entry moved to Done, node rows marked Done), and no known defect against them remains.
- [ ] Tests cover the change (a bug fix has a test that failed before).
- [ ] No secrets: no token in code, tests, logs, fixtures or screenshots.
- [ ] Security: I considered tokens, input from Discord users or files, paths, limits and new dependencies (answered in the roadmap, or here).
- [ ] A format or payload change has a migration and a sample of the old version.
- [ ] Documents are updated (`ARCHITECTURE.md`, `DECISIONS.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`) where they apply.
